children: Silver Bow Mining signed a non-binding term sheet with Ocean Partners for an ~$88M package, including a $40M concentrate prepayment facility, ~$43.1M in reclamation bond guarantees, and 10-year zinc/lead offtakes. A $5M bridge note is to fund within five business days.
Material Details
Detail
AI Analyst View
Non-binding ~$88M package signed
Signals potential liquidity boost and long-term sales channel, though not yet definitive.
$40M concentrate prepay facility
Provides near-term funding tied to future production; reduces equity need if closed.
~$43.1M bond guarantees
Could release ~$42M cash collateral, improving liquidity upon DEQ acceptance.
10-year Zn/Pb offtake agreements
Secures marketing outlet; no take-or-pay or minimum tonnage reduces pressure.
$5M bridge note in 5 business days
Near-term cash; repayable if acquisition doesn’t close by long-stop date.
Interest: 12M SOFR + 6.75%
High-cost capital; interest rate sensitivity impacts cash burn before output.
Context by AI Analyst

This is an early-stage financing framework to advance Rainbow Block and the Montana Tunnels acquisition, not a finalized deal. A signed definitive agreement, DEQ acceptance of surety, and cash release would turn this into a near-term liquidity catalyst.
